messages:
maria: heads-up — us-west2 GPU queue spiked ~3x at 20:02 UTC, started seeing 503s and long admission waits.
ajay: saw alerts. any deploys or config changes?
maria: no deploys. network shows a burst of reranking callbacks + more tokens per request. kube nodes CPU fine but GPU pods at 98% util on several nodes.
kai: can you paste the queue/admission metrics you saw? paste a small snippet if possible.
maria: sure — grabbing from grafana now, trimmed: 
```
queue_depth: 1 -> 14 -> 57 over 20:00-20:05
admit_p50_ms: 20 -> 300
admit_p95_ms: 4000
active_gpus: 42/42
pending_pods: 0
request_rate_spike: +180% in 2m
model_kv_cache_hits: down 12%
```
linda: looks like capacity saturation + no pending pods to scale in. two quick levers: smooth admission (token-bucket refill) and increase warm-provision window so provisioning can keep up. but cost tradeoff.
ajay: right — cost concern. alternative: temporarily increase scale_up_rate (faster node creation) but keep prewarm_count same to avoid steady-state cost.
maria: tried a small scale_up bump earlier, but provisioning still lagged because spot replacements and cloud quotas slowed boot times.
kai: suggestion: implement short-lived hedging warmers when admit_p95 > 1s for >10s. spawn quantized/low-memory variants (ephemeral) to absorb spikes while main pool ramps.
linda: also add a soft-shed for low-priority routes (x-priority header) so non-critical reranks/backfills get delayed or 429ed during pressure.
ajay: draft admission policy — thinking: 
```json
{
  "admission": {
    "token_bucket": { "refill_per_sec": 50, "capacity": 200 },
    "soft_shed": { "enabled": true, "low_priority_threshold": 0.6 },
    "hedging": { "enabled": true, "trigger_ms": 1000, "ephemeral_pool_size": 6 }
  },
  "autoscale": { "scale_up_rate": 4, "prewarm_window_secs": 120 }
}
```
maria: rolling a canary of that config in us-west2 to 5% traffic now to validate. will monitor for regressions.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for admission-policy v3 on us-west2 (5% traffic) — rollout_id=rb-2065432116
maria: monitoring 10m windows and watching queue_depth + admit_p95. will post initial results in 10m.
kai: also opened CLOUD-4821 to ask cloud team to confirm spot capacity and AZ throttling in us-west2 yesterday — could be correlated.
linda: if canary looks stable in 10m, promote to 50% then 100% over 30m. if regressions, automatic rollback rules apply.
ajay: add a cost check: if prewarm_window causes sustained gpu_hours > baseline + 15% for >1h, auto-revert prewarm increase.
maria: first 6m look good: queue depth dropped to median <8, admit_p95 ~220ms, 503s disappeared. continuing to monitor.
maria: next steps: add alerts for "admit_p95 > 1s for 60s" and "gpu_pool_util > 90% AND pending_pods == 0" to trigger prewarm/hedge actions, and add a runbook snippet for ops to flip soft-shed headers. :thumbsup:
